label: Неделя
description: Twelve-mission case drill for неделя (week) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form неделя is the subject of была here, so it stays in the base nominative. Soft feminine nouns in -я keep that ending in the nominative singular and need no change.

missions.phrase: У нас нет ни одной свободной недели.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive singular. After нет the noun shifts from nominative неделя to genitive недели, with the soft ending -я giving way to -и. Negation of existence with нет is a classic genitive trigger.

missions.phrase: К этой неделе мы закончим ремонт.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative singular. The preposition к governs the dative, turning неделя into неделе with the soft dative ending -е. Here it marks the time by which the action will be done.

missions.phrase: Я жду эту неделю с нетерпением.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative singular. As the direct object of жду, неделя takes the accusative неделю; soft feminine nouns change -я to -ю in the accusative singular. The inanimate noun shows a distinct accusative form.

missions.phrase: Перед этой неделей я хорошо отдохнул.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The preposition перед requires the instrumental, so неделя becomes неделей with the soft ending -ей. Stress stays on the stem, so the ending is -ей, not -ёй.

missions.phrase: На этой неделе у меня много дел.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. Locative and temporal на takes the prepositional, and неделя becomes неделе with the soft ending -е, identical in form to the dative. The phrase на неделе fixes the time frame.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural. As the subject of пролетели, the plural недели carries the soft nominative ending -и instead of singular -я. Soft feminine nouns mark the nominative plural with -и.

missions.phrase: Я не видел тебя несколько недель.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural. After несколько the count noun goes to genitive plural недель, which here is a zero ending with a soft sign marking the former soft stem. Quantity words like несколько govern the genitive plural.

missions.phrase: По неделям он ездит в командировки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative plural. The preposition по in its distributive sense takes the dative plural неделям, with the standard plural dative ending -ям after a soft stem. It conveys a recurring weekly pattern.

missions.phrase: Эти недели я провёл в деревне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative plural. As an inanimate direct object of провёл, недели has an accusative plural that matches the nominative plural. Inanimate feminine nouns keep accusative plural equal to nominative plural.

missions.phrase: Между неделями отдыха почти не было.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The preposition между governs the instrumental, giving неделями with the regular plural ending -ями after the soft stem. The instrumental plural ending is uniform across declensions.

missions.phrase: В этих неделях было много радости.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. After в the noun takes the prepositional plural неделях, ending in -ях after the soft stem. The prepositional plural ending is the same for all genders.
